name: ihateposting
description: Schedule and publish to 14 social networks from Kimi Code: X, LinkedIn, Instagram, Facebook, TikTok, YouTube, Threads, Bluesky, Pinterest, Mastodon, Telegram, Discord, Tumblr and Slack, through the hosted iHatePosting MCP server. You sign in with your iHatePosting account in the browser; there is no key to set.
skillInstructions: In Kimi Code this plugin's tools are named mcp__plugin-ihateposting_ihateposting__ followed by the tool name, for example mcp__plugin-ihateposting_ihateposting__whoami. If they are missing and a tool named mcp__plugin-ihateposting_ihateposting__authenticate is in your list, call it and show the user the address it prints, unchanged.

interface.shortDescription: Draft, check, schedule and publish social posts to 14 networks
